warnings: Hantavirus is historically rare in Virginia; the full 2025-01-01 to 2026-06-01 window may yield zero or only one case — this is an expected and valid outcome, not a data gap.
NNDSS and VDH annual surveillance reports may not be published until late 2025 or mid-2026, creating a reporting lag for the end of the time window.
Seoul virus (HFRS-associated) has been documented in the eastern US via pet rat exposure; Virginia collectors should not exclude HFRS cases.
No curated Virginia-specific hantavirus outbreak history exists for 2025; source discovery must rely on active surveillance report monitoring.
VDH may not publish individual case-level data publicly; evidence may only be available as aggregate annual counts or via MMWR case reports.
